# Simulator cards (generated by `scripts/sim_cards.py`)

Our `cards` table: 127 cards; the engine (ClashRoyaleEnv fork) has all but 1 (the 4 tower troops aside). Human replay plays: 31,389.

Mapped by name (`bot77.sim.cards`); a play's form picks the engine's Evolution or Hero id. Tower troops (Tower Princess, Cannoneer, Dagger Duchess, Royal Chef) are the engine's `TowerTroopType`, not cards.
